meta_description: Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence — composed architecture, platform stack and the metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: The contract behind Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence: signed baseline in week two, working slice by week eight, industrialized controls by week twelve, and evidence flowing to your control owner throughout.
The problem this solution exists for
Quality escapes are discovered by customers; yield losses accepted as normal; energy lacks per-unit truth; root cause takes weeks.
Our approach

We unify process/quality/energy telemetry with lineage, deploy vision and process models closing loops into line systems, and instrument the cost-per-unit metrics that operations leadership steers by.
Reference architecture

blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence
blocks.note: Contracts between stages are enforced at the boundary, so schema drift fails loudly in minutes instead of quietly in a quarter.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

blocks.x: Platform stack

The solution runs on BI & Analytics Platform and Fleet Management System: Sensor data feeds a living model of your plant, fleet or field estate, and the model drives action. The governed data estate every AI program needs.
How it runs in an engagement

items: We measure the starting position and lock the baseline with your team — no build work begins before the number is agreed.
A bounded pilot on your real data, with the gate review scheduled before the first commit is written.
Runbooks, enablement and the control trail that let your teams operate it without us in the room.
Quarterly re-audits and a ranked backlog of the next decisions worth automating — value that accumulates on purpose.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence has honest prerequisites: named owners for the source systems, contracts for the data that crosses boundaries, and access your security team has approved in writing.
How a delivery runs

The rhythm for Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence: measure first, prove on real data, industrialize what survived the gate, and review the delta every fortnight with the people accountable for the number.
Outcomes we commit to

items: scrap/rework cost is part of the steering pack from week two: current value, signed baseline and the delta since the last gate, on one line.
energy per unit is tracked weekly against the baseline signed in week two — the number at each gate is the number finance sees.

blocks.x: Where this fits in the portfolio

Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence is one entry in a wider portfolio that shares platforms, contracts and a delivery standard. The fit matters: programs compose on the same rails, so what one program builds, the next inherits.

items: The Achala IT Solutions build of Energy & Utilities: concrete interfaces at SCADA / EMS cores, measured movement on Forecast error (wind/solar/demand).
How Telecom, Media & Entertainment runs when it is engineered for Telecom, Media & Entertainment: bounded scope per gate, platform evidence generated.
Ledger activity mapped to regulatory obligations, with exceptions raised as cases.
The engagement is documented on its case page — what was measured, what moved and how the evidence was gathered.
